released_valid_population: the 186 dual rows whose released image_id exactly names one released image; the other 186 suffixless IDs each ambiguously name two files and are excluded before model inference
release_defect_policy: never guess a missing -1/-2 suffix and never choose an image using the gold answer
primary_gate: text_only initial wrong AND simultaneous final correct, within item-order
primary_metric: persistence of the exact initial wrong interpretation under text_first_actual_label
fatal_controls: matched_history must be materially weaker than text-first commitment
ordinal commitment tests persistence without exact A/B label repetition
all image-bearing conditions use the same source image bytes and processor

failure_routing.actual_without_ordinal: exact-label or response-format self-priming, not cross-modal resolution inertia
failure_routing.ordinal_not_above_masked: text-first ordering or late-image cost, not interpretation-specific inertia
